dimensions.assessment: Affects counties, parishes, municipalities, or Tribal communities located within 50 miles of a major oil or gas export port, as well as specified oil or gas corporations.
dimensions.evidence: any county, parish, municipality, or Tribal community if the Secretary determines that such county, parish, municipality, or Tribal community is located within 50 miles of a major port

dimensions.assessment: Provides funding for infrastructure and public service investments through transfer payments from a newly established federal trust fund.
dimensions.evidence: for purposes of making payments to eligible oil and gas communities for infrastructure and public service investments.

dimensions.assessment: Appropriates amounts equivalent to 3 percent of net revenues received from specified oil or gas companies into a newly established Treasury trust fund.
dimensions.evidence: There are hereby appropriated to the Oil and Gas Community Trust Fund amounts equivalent to 3 percent of the net revenues received in the Treasury under section 11

dimensions.assessment: Amends subchapter A of chapter 98 of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 to establish a new section and trust fund.
dimensions.evidence: Subchapter A of chapter 98 of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 is amended by adding at the end the following new section

dimensions.assessment: Establishes a permanent trust fund with expenditures available without fiscal year limitation for taxable years beginning after enactment.
dimensions.evidence: without need of further appropriation and without fiscal year limitation

missing_information: Exact monetary sums or dollar projections for the transferred 3 percent net revenues are not stated.
The exact number of eligible communities or ports nationwide is not specified.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill creates a dedicated trust fund using 3 percent of net revenues from specified oil and gas companies to make infrastructure and public service investments in eligible communities located within 50 miles of a major export port. It modifies the Internal Revenue Code.
